task_contract.requested: Repair the scoped F16 builder race between lstat and pathname-based hashing/scandir; reject supplied symlink roots instead of resolving them away.
task_contract.review_scope: New runs of build_path_graph.py only. Preserve stable inventory/schema compatibility while preventing followed symlink content reads and withholding hashes when checked source bindings change.
forbidden: changes to product sources by auditor
claiming global filesystem snapshot or whole product acceptance
expected_contracts: Regular file bytes are read through a no-follow descriptor matched to the no-follow observed stat, never through a reopened full source pathname.
Directory enumeration is bound to descriptors. Root components are also no-follow; explicit symlink ancestors and '..' components are rejected, not silently resolved.
Detected identity/content/active-ancestor changes cannot retain observed source hashes or complete coverage. Unreadable paths are explicit.
Stable canonical synthetic roots preserve schema1.1, inventory fields, deterministic sort, symbolic-link metadata and exact duplicate groups.
No unavailable-platform fallback silently weakens confinement. No unclosed descriptors on exercised success/failure/exception paths.
The primary audited facts are bounded test schedules and local code contracts, not real-world exploit immunity or end-to-end old-index freshness.

goal: Make newly built structural path observations descriptor-bound and fail explicitly when checked filesystem identities change.

nodes.text: All supplied root components are opened without following symlinks; parent traversal and missing facilities are rejected.
Regular-file hashing is no-follow, matches before/after identity and metadata, and reads at most the initially observed byte size.

Directory descriptors carry traversal; every detected active root/ancestor binding change immediately invalidates all emitted hashes and ends traversal, even if an ancestor is restored before the next check.
Detected failures remain unresolved and incomplete; failed directory nodes do not expose an observed source hash.

Stable canonical roots retain schema1.1, inventory shape and deterministic order. Root aliases require explicit canonical choice; old generations are not automatically certified or necessarily invalidated.

Current19 permanent tests pass on Python3.14.6 and3.9.6 with zero skips, including a real transient supplied-ancestor swap regression that failed before repair1. Earlier v1 auditor was static-only; re-audit is required.
No global snapshot, downstream Validator race repair, retrospective migration, all-resource bound, hard-link/mount provenance or full app acceptance claim.

unverified_points: This is not an atomic global filesystem snapshot. A completed file/directory can change after its final check, especially after its directory frame closes or during later publication. Answer-time freshness and final-generation revalidation remain separate F13 work.

No-follow confinement covers this builder only. validate_path_graph.py and other Readers/Validators still contain pathname reopen sequences and require separately owned repairs before any end-to-end race-safety claim.

Descriptor capability refers to the initially opened directory objects. Hard links, mount/privileged filesystem remapping, hostile filesystem metadata guarantees, and same-account compromise are not universal provenance protection.

No whole-tree item/byte/depth/deadline budget is implemented here. Name lists and records remain in memory, open descriptors scale with active depth, and blocking filesystem I/O can still require process supervision. F14 remains open.

Output-directory symlink handling, atomic publication of multiple output files, source/output overlap, unusual non-UTF8 filenames, and full app/model/GUI/package acceptance are not certified by this change.
Ancestor changes conservatively invalidate the entire observed generation, including otherwise unaffected files; this trades availability for explicit uncertainty.
factual_correction: ADDENDUM overrides EXECUTOR changes[4] about existing rebuild fingerprints; no automatic migration assurance is made.
proposed_output: Submit the scoped builder patch for independent adversarial review, then parent deterministic validation. Do not self-approve or mark F16 end-to-end safety complete.
repair_response: Round1 of max2: immediate global hash invalidation on detected active-ancestor failure after a file hash; independently suggested static issue now reproduced with real temporary inode swaps and repaired. Original v1 audit and logs remain unchanged.
